copy.headline: Texas Republicans spent billions lowering property taxes. What can Democrats do differently?
copy.caption:
Texas Democrats are considering cutting property taxes and ending corporate subsidies. Here’s what their plans could mean for taxpayers.

Texas Republican lawmakers spent years and billions of dollars trying to rein in the state’s property taxes — but many homeowners still complained their tax bills were too high. Now, after an election in which voters raised deep concerns about the cost of living, it’s Democrats’ turn to figure out how to wrangle the state’s property taxes.
